MINUTES OF MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF ZAMEEN VENTURE ONE (SMC-PRIVATE) LIMITED HELD ON THIS____________________________ 
 
 Agenda 
 
 The Board was informed that the Company desires to advance a loan in the principal amount of Rs. 204 ,000,000 (Rupees two hundred and four million) to Zameen Nord (SMC-Private) Limited (“ Borrower ”). 
 
 The Board unanimously nominated Imran Ali Khan to discuss, negotiate and accept this proposal . 
 
 Resolutions 
 
 After discussing the aforesaid matter in detail, the following resolutions were passed/approved/adopted by the Board: 
 
 Resolved that , the Company be and is hereby authorized to advance a loan in the principal amount of Rs. Rs. 204,000,000 (Rupees two hundred and four million) to the Borrower. 
 
 Resolved further that , Imran Ali Khan be and is hereby authorized and empowered to do and execute on behalf of the Company all such acts, deeds and things as may be necessary and ancillary to the aforementioned transactions. 
 
 
 
 
 ____________________ ___ 
 Company Secretary
